name: kotlinconf-preview-helper-lang
prompt: Add a composable `EmptyListMessage(text: String)` in app/shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/jetbrains/kotlinconf/screens/EmptyListMessage.kt that shows the text centred, and a light and dark preview of it. The preview shows the message inside the app theme, on the theme's main background, in a column with 8 dp of padding and 8 dp between items. Keep it small.
